summary: Phase 3 (Entregas) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (auth guard, GET auto-provisions, PUT validates estado + persists split between entrega and vehicle collections, auto-appear/disappear on ubicacion change). Frontend: KPIs correct (Hoy=1, Pendientes=0, Listas=1, Entregadas=0), 4 columns render, buscador + filters (fecha/estado/modelo/comercial/cliente) + Limpiar work, DnD via pointer events successfully moves card between columns AND persists via PUT /api/entregas. Edit dialog opens on short click and saves. ONE bug found: dialog crashes with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading marca)' after save/close because item becomes null while form state remains.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'marca'). After clicking Guardar, parent sets editItem=null but the dialog's internal `form` state is still truthy, so the `if (!form) return null` guard doesn't trip and JSX still references `item.marca`/`item.modelo`/`item.vin_corto`. Same happens when closing via Cancelar. Reproduces 100% of the time — leaves the app in an unusable error overlay until reload.

action_items: Fix EntregaEditDialog null-item crash: either (a) guard on `!item` in addition to `!form`, or (b) reset `form` to null when `item` becomes null / dialog closes, or (c) keep a local copy of item alongside form so JSX never dereferences a null parent prop. Recommended fix: change `if (!form) return null;` to `if (!form || !item) return null;` and/or reset form in useEffect when !open.
critical_code_review_comments: EntregaEditDialog: rendering depends on parent-owned `item` which can become null while dialog is still mounted during Radix close animation — the guard clause only checks `form`. Must also guard on `item`.
entregas.py _merge: fine (excludes _id) but note that `_clean(v)` is called on vehicles inside the async comprehension; safe. No issues.
PUT /api/entregas/{vehicle_id}: correctly splits fields between entrega and vehicle collections and validates estado. Good.
Entregas.js: pointer DnD implementation is clean and correctly uses >5px threshold to distinguish click vs drag. Optimistic update + refresh on both success and error is a good pattern.

rca of the issue: EntregaEditDialog: On save, `submit()` calls `onOpenChange(false)`, which in parent Entregas.js runs `(o) => !o && setEditItem(null)` making `item` null. Radix Dialog keeps content mounted during the close transition (~150ms). During that transition, React re-renders EntregaEditDialog with item=null but form still holds the previous object → the guard `if (!form) return null;` passes → JSX evaluates `{item.marca}` → TypeError. Reproduction: (1) Login → Entregas, (2) click any card, (3) click Guardar. Mitigation: change guard to `if (!form || !item) return null;` OR clear form in an effect keyed on `open`: `useEffect(() => { if (!open) setForm(null); }, [open]);`
